name: data-dictionary
title: Data dictionary
for_each: select id,name from assets where not archived order by name

sections.title: Field definitions
sections.sql: select name,data_type,description,classification from fields where asset_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Business terms
sections.sql: select t.name,t.definition,t.owner from terms t join term_links l on l.term_id=t.id where l.asset_id=$1 order by t.name

name: steward-review
title: Steward review record
for_each: select id,name from assets where not archived order by name

sections.title: Recorded decisions
sections.sql: select reviewed_on,next_due,actor,evidence from reviews where asset_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,severity,due from issues where asset_id=$1 and status='open' order by due

sections.title: Quality evidence
sections.sql: select rule,checked_on,examined,failed,evidence,actor from quality_runs where asset_id=$1 order by checked_on

name: change-impact
title: Recorded change impact
for_each: select id,name from assets where not archived order by name

sections.title: Downstream dependencies
sections.note: Only recorded asset links are traversed. Verify completeness with the source owner.
sections.sql: WITH RECURSIVE reached(id) AS (SELECT downstream_id FROM lineage WHERE upstream_id=$1 UNION SELECT l.downstream_id FROM lineage l JOIN reached r ON l.upstream_id=r.id) SELECT a.source,a.name,a.owner,a.kind FROM reached r JOIN assets a ON a.id=r.id WHERE a.id<>$1 ORDER BY a.name
